preconditions.description: The length of the text string txt must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the pattern string pat must be at least 1 and less than the length of the text string txt.
Both txt and pat must be strings.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(txt) for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned indices must be within the bounds of the text string txt.

postconditions.expression: all(txt[index-1:index-1+len(pat)] == pat for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each returned index must correspond to the start of an occurrence of the pattern pat in txt.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == 0 or all(index > 0 for index in return_value)
postconditions.description: If the pattern is not found, the return value must be an empty list; otherwise, all indices must be positive.
